biological_replicate: Patient samples were kindly donated by women with high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC; n = 2) or triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC; n = 2)
experimental_design: Comparison of ECM composition between cancer tissues and their corresponding normal/adjacent tissues (TNBC vs adjacent breast; HGSOC omental metastasis vs normal omentum)

We illustrate this protocol with ECMs obtained from two pairs of tissues, which differ in ECM content and cellularity: triple-negative breast cancer and adjacent mammary tissue, and omental metastasis from high-grade serous ovarian cancer and normal omentum.
factor_value: tissue type (TNBC, adjacent breast, HGSOC omental metastasis, normal omentum)
triple-negative breast cancer and adjacent mammary tissue, and omental metastasis from high-grade serous ovarian cancer and normal omentum
number_of_fractions: The fractions were concatenated into 15 fractions non-contiguously
number_of_biological_replicates: for the four tissues analyzed (breast cancer and adjacent breast tissue samples and omentum and ovarian-cancer-derived omental metastasis samples; n = 2 for each sample type)
number_of_samples: for the four tissues analyzed (breast cancer and adjacent breast tissue samples and omentum and ovarian-cancer-derived omental metastasis samples; n = 2 for each sample type)
